Dreamyard B1F.quote: In {{game|Black and White|s}}, the {{player}} encounters some {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s here who are kicking a {{p|Munna}} to get its [[Dream Mist]]. {{m|Cut}} is required to access the building area. After beating [[Ghetsis]] and [[N]], the orange traffic cone is removed. This allows access to the basement and the other portion of the area, where [[Gorm]] of the [[Seven Sages]] can be found and arrested.

Abundant Shrine.quote: The '''Abundant Shrine''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|ほうじょうの社|ほうじょうのやしろ}}''' ''Fertility Shrine'') is a location within the eastern half of the [[Unova]] [[region]]. It is connected to {{rt|14|Unova}} at its southern exit and can only be accessed via {{m|Surf}} and {{m|Waterfall}}. The land surrounding the actual shrine is a field of mounds of soil and a few bodies of water.

Guidance Chamber.quote: Go south and push the boulder to the hole in the floor. Walk east past {{tc|Hiker}} Hugh and move the second boulder to the next hole. Head north along the east wall to fight {{tc|Hiker}} Clarke, and pick up the [[Max Repel]]. Grab the [[Hyper Potion]] to the northwest, and move the third boulder into place to create a shortcut. Climb the stairway to the second floor.

Pinwheel Forest Rumination Field.quote: In Pokémon Black and White, the east portion of the inner forest is initially blocked by an old man, and goes away after the player obtains the [[Bicycle]]. At the deep end of this area holds the entrance to Rumination Field where the Legendary Pokémon {{p|Virizion}} resides; this area is only accessible after the player battles {{p|Cobalion}}.

Mistralton Cave.quote: '''Mistralton Cave''' (Japanese: '''フキヨセの{{tt|洞穴|ほらあな}}''' ''Fukiyose Cave'') is a cave located on {{rt|6|Unova}} in the western half of the [[Unova]] [[region]]. It can be accessed by using {{m|Surf}} from Route 6; in {{B2W2}}, Mistralton Cave can also be accessed via the [[Clay Tunnel]]'s western terminus. {{m|Flash}} is needed to fully illuminate the cave.

Giant Chasm Forest Cave.quote: When the {{player}} reaches the pond in the middle of the crater, the forest will freeze and be completely covered in snow, thus giving the player access to the cave {{p|Kyurem}} is hiding. Once the player has captured or defeated Kyurem and left the area, the snow will disappear, and the northern portion of the caves [[List of unrevisitable locations|will no longer be accessible]]. If Kyurem is defeated, however, the area will become accessible again after entering the [[Hall of Fame]] once more and returning to the pond in the center of the crater.

Dragonspiral Tower 7F.quote: This unlock requirement cannot be bypassed with Pokémon Bank or Pokémon HOME. This ensures that the player will be able to (and forced to) catch the required Legendary Pokémon, unlike in [[Pokémon Black and White Versions|Pokémon Black and White]] where the otherwise mandatory catching of {{p|Reshiram}}{{sup/5|B}}/{{p|Zekrom}}{{sup/5|W}} can be bypassed by completely filling the party and all 720 spaces in the storage system beforehand.

Trial Chamber.quote: In {{game|Black and White|s}}, the '''Trial Chamber''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|試練の室|しれんのむろ}}''' ''Trial Room''), home of the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Terrakion}}, is located here. However, in order to access this area, the {{player}} must have first encountered {{p|Cobalion}}, who resides in [[Mistralton Cave]].

Liberty Garden.quote: In {{game|Black and White|s}}, the ship will only take the {{player}} if they have the [[Liberty Pass]], which is an {{pkmn2|event}}-exclusive item. On the player's first visit, some members of [[Team Plasma]] are already here upon the player's arrival, and they will battle the player.

Unova Route 9.quote: In {{2v2|Black|White}}, the entrance to the Tubeline Bridge from this route is blocked by two {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s. They will only disperse once the {{player}} obtains the [[Light Stone]]{{sup/5|Bl}}/[[Dark Stone]]{{sup/5|W}}. Once they have dispersed, [[Bianca]] will meet the player at this position for a battle.

chapters.title: Pinwheel Forest and Castelia
chapters.quote: Pinwheel Forest is a vast, forested stretch of land that extends over a large area in southeastern Unova. It is divided into two separate sectors. In Pokémon Black and White, the exterior is the only section of the forest available to explore before obtaining the {{badge|Basic}}, because a group of {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s stand in the way just a few steps into the interior, preventing access to Pokémon living there.

chapters.title: Driftveil and Route 6
chapters.quote: Driftveil Drawbridge is inaccessible until after the player battles the two Preschoolers{{sup/5|BW}} or [[Charles]]{{sup/5|B2W2}}, both of which can only be battled after [[Elesa]] has been defeated.

chapters.title: Chargestone Cave to Mistralton
chapters.quote: As you approach [[Chargestone Cave]], you find a large {{p|Galvantula}} web blocking the entrance. [[Clay]] shows up with his {{p|Krokorok}} and removes it for you, then hands you {{TM|78|Bulldoze}} as a reward for defeating him at the Gym.

chapters.title: Surf detours
chapters.quote: Now that you have access to the HM for Surf, you can get some items in places previously visited, and even go to some new ones.

chapters.title: Dragonspiral Tower
chapters.quote: In {{game|Black and White|s}}, the first accessible portion of Dragonspiral Tower is the entrance north of Icirrus City, due to the tower itself being surrounded by a moat that cannot be traversed using {{m|Surf}}. After the player obtains the {{badge|Freeze}}, [[Team Plasma]] will break through the wall of the tower with a ramp, giving the player access to the inside of the tower, as well as the previously-inaccessible grassland on the other side of the moat. In {{B2W2}}, the ramp is still there, giving the player immediate access to the tower after reaching Icirrus City.

chapters.title: Relic Castle depths and Opelucid
chapters.quote: After [[N]] has awakened {{p|Zekrom}}{{sup/5|Bl}}/{{p|Reshiram}}{{sup/5|W}} at [[Dragonspiral Tower]], the next few floors have been cleared up, allowing the player to venture deeper into the castle, which, at this point, is filled with {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s. At the lowest reachable floor, the player will encounter [[Alder]] and [[Ghetsis]], with the latter giving a brief speech before leaving.

chapters.title: Victory Road
chapters.quote: The Badge Check Gates are the final man-made obstacle standing between you and the Pokémon League. Each Badge opens a different gate, and the rooms between are designed in a style reminiscent of each Gym. Show your Badges to the eight guards, and Victory Road stands tall before you.

chapters.title: After Team Plasma
chapters.quote: '''Route 11''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|１１番道路|１１ばんどうろ}}''' ''Route 11'') is a route located in northern [[Unova]], connecting [[Opelucid City]] to the [[Village Bridge]]. In {{2v2|Black|White}}, it cannot be accessed until the {{player}} stops [[Team Plasma]]. In {{B2W2|Black 2 and White 2}}, after Opelucid City is frozen by the [[Plasma Frigate]], part of the road here on Route 11 will also be frozen while the ice remains, forcing the player to slide across the ice to travel to either side.

events.label: Have Clay clear Chargestone Cave
events.q: Has Clay removed the web at the entrance to Chargestone Cave?
events.quote: As you approach [[Chargestone Cave]], you find a large {{p|Galvantula}} web blocking the entrance. [[Clay]] shows up with his {{p|Krokorok}} and removes it for you, then hands you {{TM|78|Bulldoze}} as a reward for defeating him at the Gym.

events.label: See N awaken the dragon
events.q: Did you see N awaken Zekrom or Reshiram atop Dragonspiral Tower?
events.quote: On the top floor, [[N]] is befriending the legendary Pokémon {{p|Zekrom}}{{sup/5|Bl}} / {{p|Reshiram}}{{sup/5|Wh}}. The dragon recognizes N as a hero. N tells you that if you want to stop him, you must become a hero as well. He tells you to look for the other dragon, and flies off with his new ally.

events.label: Receive the Light Stone or Dark Stone
events.q: Has Lenora given you the Light Stone or Dark Stone at Nacrene Museum?
events.quote: When you reach the museum, [[Professor Juniper]], [[Cedric Juniper]], [[Bianca]], and [[Alder]] are waiting for you. The professor says that you are caught up in something serious. [[Lenora]] leaves the museum and hands you the [[Light Stone]]{{sup/5|Bl}}/[[Dark Stone]]{{sup/5|Wh}}. Alder asks if you are ready to battle [[N]] if anything happens to him, and Lenora remembers that "[[Drayden|those]] [[Iris|two]]" in [[Opelucid City]] are {{type|Dragon}} specialists. {{m|Fly}} back to [[Icirrus City]] and go northeast to {{rt|8|Unova}}.

events.label: Defeat N and Ghetsis
events.q: Did you defeat N and Ghetsis at N's Castle and see the credits?
events.quote: Ghetsis can't believe that he, "the perfect ruler of a perfect new world," was defeated. He laughs evilly and then explains that he told N to become the hero. Ghetsis couldn't meet the Legendary dragon because the dragon will only obey someone with a pure heart. Alder and Cheren take him into custody, and N explains that he wanted to battle you again and again because he couldn't believe that your Pokémon were happy with you. You and him walk to the back of the room, where he releases his dragon through the hole in the wall and bids you farewell.

events.label: Battle Cobalion
events.q: Have you battled Cobalion in Mistralton Cave?
events.quote: The old man approaches you after the battle, and says that because {{p|Cobalion}} is starting to trust you, {{p|Terrakion}} and {{p|Virizion}} will give you a chance to battle them, as well. Terrakion is hidden deep in {{OBP|Victory Road|Black and White}}, out of reach for now. Virizion, however, is waiting in Rumination Field, on the eastern side of [[Pinwheel Forest]].

events.label: Obtain the event Liberty Pass
events.q: Do you have the event-distributed Liberty Pass?
events.quote: In {{game|Black and White|s}}, the ship will only take the {{player}} if they have the [[Liberty Pass]], which is an {{pkmn2|event}}-exclusive item. On the player's first visit, some members of [[Team Plasma]] are already here upon the player's arrival, and they will battle the player.

events.label: Bring the event Celebi
events.q: Do you have the fateful-encounter Celebi and a spare Poké Ball for Zorua?
events.quote: In Black and White, a girl on the ground floor will tell a story about a Pokémon that can cause {{a|illusion}}s and then show the player a photo of {{p|Zorua}}, thus adding it to the [[Pokédex]]. Next to her is a young boy who does not talk. If the player has a [[fateful encounter]] {{p|Celebi}} in their party and talks to the boy, Celebi will come out of its Poké Ball, and the boy will reveal himself to actually be a {{p|Zorua}}, who will then join the player if they have a {{i|Poké Ball}} to spare.

events.label: Bring an event Shiny legendary beast
events.q: Have you brought an event Shiny Raikou, Entei or Suicune to Lostlorn Forest?
events.quote: If the player approaches the trailer here with one of the {{DL|Legendary beasts (M13)|In the games|event}} {{Shiny}} [[Legendary beasts]] here, they will activate a special in-game event. The mysterious, silent woman will emerge from the trailer with a screeching growl and attack the player.

events.label: Bring Tornadus and Thundurus
events.q: Are Tornadus and Thundurus in your party, with your own version’s roamer bearing your Trainer ID?
events.quote: A {{p|Landorus}} appears here if both {{p|Tornadus}} and {{p|Thundurus}} are in the party. The Tornadus{{sup/5|B}}/Thundurus{{sup/5|W}} must have the player's [[Trainer ID number]]. If defeated or run from, it respawns after entering the [[Hall of Fame]].

events.label: Defer the castle dragon catch
events.q: Did a full party and all 24 full PC boxes prevent you catching the dragon at the castle?
events.quote: This unlock requirement cannot be bypassed with Pokémon Bank or Pokémon HOME. This ensures that the player will be able to (and forced to) catch the required Legendary Pokémon, unlike in [[Pokémon Black and White Versions|Pokémon Black and White]] where the otherwise mandatory catching of {{p|Reshiram}}{{sup/5|B}}/{{p|Zekrom}}{{sup/5|W}} can be bypassed by completely filling the party and all 720 spaces in the storage system beforehand.

events.label: Freeze the Giant Chasm crater
events.q: Have you reached the central pond and covered Giant Chasm in snow?
events.quote: When the {{player}} reaches the pond in the middle of the crater, the forest will freeze and be completely covered in snow, thus giving the player access to the cave {{p|Kyurem}} is hiding. Once the player has captured or defeated Kyurem and left the area, the snow will disappear, and the northern portion of the caves [[List of unrevisitable locations|will no longer be accessible]]. If Kyurem is defeated, however, the area will become accessible again after entering the [[Hall of Fame]] once more and returning to the pond in the center of the crater.

row_needs.quote: Pick up a [[Rare Candy]] to the northwest, then go south and drop the final two boulders into position. Head northwest to find {{p|Cobalion}}.
Move the boulder into place, then go west. This part of the cave is known as the Trial Chamber.

If the player approaches the trailer here with one of the {{DL|Legendary beasts (M13)|In the games|event}} {{Shiny}} [[Legendary beasts]] here, they will activate a special in-game event. The mysterious, silent woman will emerge from the trailer with a screeching growl and attack the player.

Speak to the {{tc|Backpacker}} on the west side of first floor, right side. She has been carrying around a pair of [[Fossil]]s, and will let you choose one to keep. The [[Cover Fossil]] will become the {{2t|Water|Rock}} {{p|Tirtouga}}, while the [[Plume Fossil]] will become the {{2t|Rock|Flying}} {{p|Archen}}. You can return to the museum in [[Nacrene City]] anytime and talk to the woman near the entrance to resurrect the ancient Pokémon.

Many people visiting [[Nimbasa City]] stop by at Route 16 to rest. The route contains a grassy area to the north and is surrounded by wooden fences. There are a few buildings that can not be entered at the western end of the route, and the paved path continues eastward past the fenced area to [[Marvelous Bridge]]. The first entrance in the wooden fence can be entered easily, and leads to Lostlorn Forest. It is covered in patches of [[tall grass]]. The second area requires {{m|Strength}}, which then leads to several patches of {{DL|Tall grass|dark grass}}. After passing the fenced area, the {{player}} can continue to Marvelous Bridge.

After heading east from Opelucid City, the player will see a patch of grass to the north, and directly in front of them, a {{tc|Backpacker}}. After facing the Backpacker, there is a {{tc|Pokémon Ranger}} standing on a bridge. After facing the Trainer, a river can be seen. The player can surf north briefly and then go up a {{OBP|waterfall|obstacle}}. There is a patch of tall grass above the waterfall to the left. Or they may surf east, then south and go down another waterfall. Once on land, there are dark patches of grass, another Pokémon Ranger, and the Protector item. Across the bridge, there is a parked trailer. To the right, there is yet another Backpacker, and the route continues to the [[Village Bridge]].

Phenomena will only appear after the {{player}} receives their first [[Badge]].

Pick up the [[Revive]] to the west, then go south to find the next of the sages. Gorm jumps out from behind the wall, and tells you about [[Team Plasma]] and [[N's Castle]]. He gives you {{TM|75|Swords Dance}} before [[Looker]] shows up to arrest him. Head west to find a [[Hyper Potion]], move the boulder to create a shortcut, and go back down to the basement to grab {{TM|85|Dream Eater}} from the north corner. On Fridays only, a {{p|Musharna}} will appear in the eastern patch of grass. This is the only Musharna that can have the [[Hidden Ability]] {{a|Telepathy}}, so make sure to catch it!
